text: It seems paradoxical that the generation with the most ways to communicate should also report the highest levels of loneliness. In my view, this problem has several causes, including the nature of online communication and changes in how young people live and study, and it can be addressed through action by schools, communities and individuals.

One major cause is that online contact often replaces rather than supports face-to-face friendship. Scrolling through other people's carefully edited lives can make young people feel left out, and short messages rarely provide the kind of deep conversation that builds genuine closeness. At the same time, social patterns have changed. Many young adults move to large cities for study or work, far from family and childhood friends, and increasing numbers live alone. Remote study and work, which became common after the pandemic, have further reduced everyday opportunities to meet people.

Solving the problem requires creating more chances for real-world connection. Universities and employers can play a key role by organising clubs, mentoring schemes and shared spaces that encourage students and new staff to meet regularly. Local authorities could support youth centres and community events, which are often the first activities to lose funding. Schools, meanwhile, should teach young people how to use social media in a healthier way, for example by recognising when online comparison is affecting their mood.

In conclusion, loneliness among young people is driven both by the limits of online communication and by social changes that separate them from others. The most effective response combines structured opportunities to meet in person with education about healthy technology use, so that technology supports friendship rather than replacing it.

note.en: A paradox to open the essay.
A precise contrast: replaces rather than supports.

strengths.en: The task mentions technology and lifestyle, and the writer covers both.

note.en: Introduction: a paradox as a hook and a thesis answering both parts of the question.
note.kk: Кіріспе: парадокс назар аудару үшін және сұрақтың екі бөлігіне жауап беретін тезис.
note.ru: Введение: парадокс как зацепка и тезис, который отвечает на обе части вопроса.

note.en: Causes: the nature of online contact and changes in lifestyle — both options in the task are covered.
note.kk: Себептер: онлайн-қарым-қатынастың табиғаты және өмір салтының өзгеруі. Тапсырмадағы екі нұсқа да қаралған.
note.ru: Причины: природа онлайн-общения и изменение образа жизни. Оба варианта из задания рассмотрены.

note.en: Solutions: for universities, authorities and schools — each matching a cause.
note.kk: Шешімдер: университеттерге, билікке және мектептерге — әр шешім өз себебіне жауап береді.
note.ru: Решения: для университетов, властей и школ — каждое решение отвечает на свою причину.

note.en: Conclusion: causes and solutions in two sentences.
note.kk: Қорытынды: себептер мен шешімдер екі сөйлемде.
note.ru: Вывод: причины и решения в двух предложениях.
